name: kdc-engine
description: Kirby's Dream Course reimplemented on Koota x Phaser 4 (see ../plans/port_v1_koota_phaser4.md)

scripts.traces: python3 ../tools/snesstep/trace_ball.py all --out ../build/engine/rom-test && for s in web_flow:4700 web_ui:3300 web_fly:4400 web_fly_spin:4400 web_curve:3700 web_hole:4700 web_tomatoes:5200 web_haz80:3000 web_haz98:3000 web_haz94:3000 web_hazad:3000 web_hazac:3000 web_arrow:3100 web_ramps:3100 web_step:3100 web_warp:3000 web_warp_fly:3000 web_boost:3000 web_boost_side:3000; do python3 ../tools/snesstep/trace_flow.py ${s%:*} --frames ${s#*:} --out ../build/engine/rom-test || exit 1; done && for n in web_haz80 web_haz98 web_haz94 web_hazad web_hazac; do python3 ../tools/snesstep/trace_actors.py $n --frames 3000 --out ../build/engine/rom-test || exit 1; done
scripts.e2e: node test/e2e/smoke.mjs && node test/e2e/courses.mjs && node test/e2e/random.mjs
